name: Translocation
description: Picks up a unit within %cast_range% tiles and sets it down elsewhere - itself up to %self_range% tiles, an ally up to %ally_range%, an enemy up to %enemy_range%.
details: The destination must be a free tile.

upgrade.summary: Reaches any unit on the map, and swaps two units if aimed at an occupied tile.
upgrade.description: Picks up any unit anywhere on the map and sets it down elsewhere - itself up to %self_range% tiles, an ally up to %ally_range%, an enemy up to %enemy_range%.
details: Only the throw is limited now, not the reach - distance to the unit being moved no longer matters at all.
The destination may be occupied, in which case the two units trade places.
